items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: recorded on a label called Banner and Russell used the name of Lou and his ginger-snaps.

ctx.x: I never knew how long Higgy had been with Russell or when he came to New York but we were both happy to see each other after the year we had been with Helvey and before that when we were amateurs. I told him that I was married and that my wife had known his sister in Cincy.

Red Allen played first trumpet on everything and took all the solos. Of course Higgy had plenty of solos and so did most everybody except me. Finally I got a one chorus solo on a number called 'Feeling the Spirit', which was recorded the 9th September along with 'The new call of the Freaks' and 'Jersey Lightning'. This was my second recording date and for the third one also with Russell, I had an 8 bar solo in the middle of the second chorus of a number called 'Broadway Rhythm' recorded on a label called Banner…
Eventually I got a solo on a head arrangement of Sweet Sue. But I never played a first part or had any other solos.
